calibration_split: allenai/c4 en train (setup_data.py streams rows of the supplied candidate list)
c4_eval_split: allenai/c4 en validation (different split from calibration: disjoint by construction)

hellaswag_protocol.split: Rowan/hellaswag validation, 2,000 supplied row IDs (seed 6304); diagnostic subset = first 512
hellaswag_protocol.tokenization: lm-eval _encode_pair: trailing context spaces moved to continuation; continuation tokens = enc(context+continuation)[len(enc(context)):]; no special tokens
hellaswag_protocol.score: sum of log p(continuation tokens | context), zero-shot
hellaswag_protocol.acc_norm: argmax of summed log-likelihood / len(ending string in characters) (no token normalization)
